paid_semantics: A charged objective scheduler call, including a scheduler rejection. The canonical call is separate; 255 expansion calls plus canonical equals 256.
fusion_interpretation: Attempted/materialized/paid distinguish tested materializer rejections from unattempted queue entries. Zero materialized tested edges does not prove every unattempted fusion edge is illegal.
fission_interpretation: complete_cut_action_count is the pass-start prepared-source legal-cut catalog. An empty catalog supplies no fission action to schedule; this is a limitation of the current legal domain.
menu_count_semantics: Menu/generated queue counts can include the same unattempted edge at multiple refreshes. They are not counts of distinct legal materialized candidates.
